bibliographic.title: Raven & Cardinal
bibliographic.author: Norbez Jones (call me Bez)
bibliographic.description:
After a successful mission, two transmasculine confidence men have a conversation on the phone.

This is the last of the games I made for Shufflecomp 2024 (you can play the 1st one here and the 2nd one here).. and features voice acting by Magnus October & StudVA.  The song that inspired it is Counting Cards by Rainbow Kitten Surprise.  When listening to it, I had this thought of a con man at the poker table, manipulating the game, narrating the song.  And then I asked myself, who is he talking to?  And that's how this game came to be.

Let me know your thoughts on it!

-- Bez (e/he)
